links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses to patient restorative dentistry questions (FRES etc.)
links.effect: DeepSeek-V3.2 was most readable, with FRES 60.85 ± 8.2 (p < 0.001), which is still only standard/fairly difficult; other models were reported as variable in readability.
links.quote: The readability measurements showed that overall, DeepSeek-V3.2 produced more readable texts with higher FRES values (60.85 ± 8.2) (p < 0.001).

screen.reason: The study empirically compares multiple LLMs on accuracy, empathy, and readability when answering restorative dentistry patient questions, but it evaluates model performance alone without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
